help.faq.cycle-predictions.question: Nguva yangu inotevera inoverengerwa sei?
help.faq.cycle-predictions.subtitle: Kufungidzira kunobva pane zvakaitika kwauri pachako.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.answer: AWA inofungidzira nguva yako inotevera, hwindo rekuzvara uye ovulation kubva pane zvawakamboita, nguva yako yekupedza nguva, uye mashoko aunonyora.
help.faq.cycle-flow.question: Ndinoziva sei kuti ndinotenderera sei?
help.faq.cycle-flow.subtitle: Ronga kuti ropa rako rinoshanduka sei.
help.faq.cycle-flow.answer: Shandisa magazini inonzi Daily kuti uone kuti unoenda sei kumwedzi.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.question: Zviratidzo zvakarongwa pakarenda zvinorevei?
help.faq.cycle-calendar.subtitle: Nguva, kubereka, ovulation uye karenda yeHijri.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.answer: Karenda yacho inoratidza mazuva ako akapindwa muropa pamwe chete neakafungidzirwa kuti une mwana uye kuti uri kubuda ovulation. Kana zviratidzo zvomudzimu zvashanda, zuva reHijri rinogonawo kuratidzwa pamwe chete nerokuti reGregorian.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.questio: Ndinoziva sei kuti ndiri munhu ane chibereko?
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.subtitl: Ona mazuva anofungidzirwa kuva akaorera zvikuru.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.answer: MuMudhi Kuedza Kufungidzira, AWA inoratidza hwindo rinobudirira rinotarisirwa zvichienderana nemashoko ako emutambo uye nhoroondo yako.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.question: Kubuda kwangu ovulation kunofungidzirwa sei?
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.subtitle: Kufungidzira kunovandudzwa sezvo iwe kuteedzera.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.answer: Kuwedzerwa kwezvibereko kunofungidzirwa kubva pane zvaunoziva kubva munhoroondo yako yemwedzi.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.question: Ndinogona kuongorora tembiricha yangu yepasi here?
help.faq.conceive-temperature.subtitle: Wedzera tembiricha yako pakutsvaka kwako kubereka.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.answer: Hungu, kuongorora tembiricha yebasa iri chikamu chebasa rokugadzira.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.answer: Hungu, kuongorora mucus ye cervical ndechimwe chezvinhu zvinowanika mu Trying to Conceive mode.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.question: Ndinogona here kuongorora kuora kweLH?
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.subtitle: Ramba uchitsvaka zvaunowana.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.answer: Hungu, kuongorora kuongorora kweLH ovulation chikamu chebasa rokubereka.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.question: Ndinofanira kuitei kuti ndione kuti ndinoita sei zvepabonde?
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.subtitle: Chinhu chakavanzika chiri mubhuku rako.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.answer: Chikamu cheUshamwari hunoita kuti unyore zvaunoita pabonde uye zvimwe zvinhu zvine chokuita nazvo.
help.faq.contraception-method.question: Ndedzipi nzira dzokudzivirira pamuviri dzandinogona kutevera?
help.faq.contraception-method.subtitle: Mapiritsi, mhete, patch uye kurapwa kwehomoni.
help.faq.contraception-method.answer: AWA inotsigira kutevera mapiritsi ekudzivirira pamuviri, mhete yechibereko, patch yekudzivirira pamuviri, uye mamwe marapirwo ehormone.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.que: Ndinogona here kuisa chiyeuchidzo chepiritsi rangu?
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.ans: Hungu. AWA inopa zviyeuchidzo zvinogona kuitwa kuti zvienderane nezvinodiwa pakutora piritsi rako, pamwe chete nokuudzwa zuva nezuva.
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.qu: Ndinogona here kunyora kuti ndakapotsa ndisina kupora here?
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.an: Hungu, kuongorora mishonga yakarasika chikamu cherwendo rwokuita kuti urware.
help.faq.contraception-history.question: Ndekupi kwandingawana nhoroondo yangu yokunwa?
help.faq.contraception-history.subtitle: Ongorora mishonga yako yakanyorwa uye mishonga yakarasika.
help.faq.contraception-history.answer: Nhoroondo yekutora inowanika kuti uone kuti unokwanisa sei kushandisa nzira dzokuzvidzivirira pamuviri.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.quest: Kufanotaura kuchiri kubatsira here paunenge uchishandisa nzira dzokudzivirira pamuviri?
help.faq.contraception-predictions.subti: Dzimwe nzira dzinogona kuchinja maitiro ako.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.answe: AWA inogona kuramba ichiratidza mashoko ekutevera aripo, asi kuti unodudzira sei kufanotaura kunobva pane zvauri kuita uye nzira yaunoshandisa.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.question: Kutenderera kwenguva refu kunoonekwa se"kunonoka" here?
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.subtitle: AWA inokonzera kutenderera kusiri kwakanaka.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.answer: Kwete. MuSOPK/Irregular cycles mode, AWA haimbobata nguva refu se "inononoka".
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.question: Ndichiratidza zviratidzo zvipi kana ndine PCOS?
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.subtitle: Ona kuti zviratidzo zvacho zvinoshanduka sei nekufamba kwenguva.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.answer: Kutevera kunosanganisira kutenderera kusiri pamutemo, acne, kukura kwebvudzi, kuchinja kwehuremu uye zviratidzo zvakabatana.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.question: Ndinogona kuongorora zvitema uye kukura kwebvudzi here?
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.subtitle: Wedzera kuongorora kwako PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.answer: Hungu, acne nokukura kwebvudzi zviri pachena kuti zvinoenderana nePCOS.
help.faq.irregular-weight.question: Ndinogona here kuongorora kuchinja kwokurema kwangu?
help.faq.irregular-weight.subtitle: Ona kuti uremu hwako hunochinja sei nekufamba kwenguva.
help.faq.irregular-weight.answer: Hungu. Kuongorora uremu kunowanika muPCOS/Irregular Cycles mode.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.question: Nei zvandinofanotaura zvichichinja-chinja?
help.faq.irregular-predictions.subtitle: Kutenderera kusiri kwakarongeka kunoita kuti kuyerwa kusasimba.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.answer: Kana kutenderera kusingaenderani, kuyerwa kunogona kuchinja zvikuru. AWA inoshandisa nhoroondo yako pachako pasina kungodudzira kutenderera kwenguva refu sekunonoka.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.question: Ndedzipi dzimwe pfungwa dzandingaziva?
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.subtitle: Kutevera kunoenderana nokuchinja kuri kuitika panguva ino youpenyu.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.answer: Kutevera kunosanganisira kupisa, kutuka usiku, matambudziko okurara, kuneta, kuchinja kwemanzwiro uye mhute muuropi, pakati pevamwe.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.question: Ndinogona here kunyora kupisa kwangu?
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.subtitle: Ona kuti zvinofamba sei nekufamba kwenguva.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.answer: Hungu. kupisa kunopisa ndechimwe chezviratidzo zviripo mumamiriro ezvinhu ePerimenopause/Menopause.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.question: Ndinogona here kuongorora kurara kwangu uye kuneta?
help.faq.menopause-sleep.subtitle: Ona matambudziko ekurara uye kuneta.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.answer: Hungu, matambudziko okurara, kutuka usiku uye kuneta zvose zviripo parwendo urwu.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.su: Ramba uchiwana mashoko anobatsira pakutevera kwako.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.an: Hungu, unogona kuongorora kurapwa kwehomoni sechikamu cheiyi nzira.
help.faq.menopause-labs.question: Ndinogona here kunyora mibairo yangu yeFSH uye estradiol?
help.faq.menopause-labs.subtitle: Wedzera zvimwe zvabuda mumarabhoritari pakutsvaka kwako.
help.faq.menopause-labs.answer: Hungu, zvabuda mu laboratori zvakadai seFSH uye estradiol zvinogona kuiswa mumamiriro ezvinhu aya.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.question: Zuva rangu rokuberekwa rinobvumwa sei?
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.subtitle: Kufungidzira kunoratidzwa mukutevera kwako pamuviri.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.answer: Kuongorora pamuviri kunoverenga zuva rako rokuberekwa rinotarisirwa kubva pane zvaunowana.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.question: Ndinogona kuongorora pamuviri wangu vhiki nevhiki here?
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.subtitle: Tarisa mberi kwaunenge uri pamuviri vhiki nevhiki.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.answer: Hungu. AWA inopa kuongorora kwevhiki nevhiki uye inoratidza kuti pamuviri wako uri kufambira mberi sei.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.question: Ndinogona here kunyora nguva dzangu dzokurapa?
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.subtitle: Isa misangano yako inokosha panzvimbo imwe chete.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.answer: Hungu, kusangana navanachiremba uye kuongorora kunokosha chikamu chokuongorora pamuviri.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.question: Ndinogona kuwana zviyeuchidzo zvemiedzo yangu?
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.subtitle: Gadzira zviyeuchidzo zvaunofanira kuyeuka.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.answer: Hungu. Pane zviyeuchidzo zvakagadzirirwa nguva dzokuenda kunopinda misangano uye bvunzo dzinokosha.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.question: Chii chandingatevera panguva yokusununguka kwangu?
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.subtitle: Zviratidzo, uremu, mafungiro, kurara uye mashoko evanhu.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.answer: Kuongorora pamuviri kunogona kusanganisira zviratidzo zvaunonzwa, uremu, mafungiro, kurara uye mashoko ezvokurapa.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.question: Ndinoziva sei kuti ndoita sei?
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.subtitle: Ona kuti kubuda kwacho kunotora nguva yakareba sei uye kuti kunobuda sei.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.answer: Kuongorora pashure pokuberekwa kunosanganisira nguva yaitika lochia, kuti inofamba sei, uye zviratidzo zvakabatana nazvo.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.questio: Ndinoziva sei kuti nguva yangu iri kudzoka?
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.subtitl: Ona kuti kutenderera kwako kunotangazve zvishoma nezvishoma.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.answer: AWA inotarisa kudzoka kwako kwezuva, kutangazve kwemwedzi wako, uye kuchinja kwako kwehomoni mushure mekuberekwa.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.questi: Ndinogona kuongorora kudyisa uye kudyisa here?
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.subtit: Chengeta mashoko aya parwendo rwako rwokuzvarwa.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.answer: Hungu, kuyamwisa uye amenorrhea yepashure pokuberekwa chikamu chechirongwa chokutevera chiripo.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.question: Chii chandingatevera pandinenge ndichipora?
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.subtitle: Kuneta, kurara, mafungiro, marwadzo uye kupora mumuviri.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.answer: Kuongorora zuva nezuva pashure pokuberekwa kunosanganisira kuneta, kurara, mafungiro, kurwadziwa uye kupora mumuviri, pakati pevamwe.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.question: AWA inobata sei nifas?
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.subtitle: Chinhu chinoratidza chitendero, chakaparadzaniswa nekutsvaga zvokurapa.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.answer: Kana zviratidzo zvomudzimu zvashanda, AWA inogona kuteedzera nguva yekuberekwa kweropa uye kuratidza nzvimbo yeiyo nifas maererano nechitendero chakasarudzwa.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.question: Ndinoziva sei kuti ndinotanga kubuda ropa?
help.faq.loss-bleeding.subtitle: Ona kuti iri kukura sei, usamhanyira kumashure.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.answer: Rwendo rwaAfter a Miscarriage runoratidza kuti ropa rinopera sei uye kuti rinokura sei, munzvimbo yakanyatsokodzera nguva iyi.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.question: Ndinoziva sei kuti kutenderera kwangu kuri kudzoka?
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.subtitle: Ramba uchitevera zvauri kuita.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.answer: AWA inotarisa kuti nguva yako inodzoka sei pashure pokubvisa pamuviri, ichikubvumira kuti zvishoma nezvishoma udzore nhoroondo yako pasina kumanikidza nguva yako yokurapa pakarepo.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.question: Ndedzipi zviratidzo zvandingaita?
help.faq.loss-symptoms.subtitle: Tarisa uone zviratidzo zvaunoda kuona.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.answer: Kutevera zviratidzo zvomuviri kunowanika parwendo urwu.
help.faq.loss-notes.question: Ndinogona kuchengeta zvinyorwa zvangu here?
help.faq.loss-notes.subtitle: Nzvimbo yomunhu oga muzuva rako.
help.faq.loss-notes.answer: Hungu, pane zvinyorwa zvomunhu oga zvinokufambisa panguva ino.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.question: Ndinogona kudzokera pakuedza kubata pamuviri pashure?
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.subtitle: Chinja chinangwa chako pose paunoda kuedzazve.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.answer: Kutsigira kuenderera mberi nekuedza kubata pamuviri kwakavakirwa mukati. Kuchinja chinangwa chako kunoramba kuri zvishoma nezvishoma uye nguva dzose kusarudzo yako pachako.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.question: Karenda yeHijri inoshanda sei?
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.subtitle: Inoratidza zuva reHijri pamwe chete neregregorian.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.answer: Kana zviratidzo zvomudzimu zvashanda, AWA inogona kuratidza zuva reHijri pamwe chete nezuva reGregorian uye kuratidza mwedzi inokosha yakadai seRamadan kana Dhul Hijjah.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.question: Kuva munhu akachena kunorevei?
help.faq.spiritual-purity.subtitle: Chiratidzo chakarerekera pakudzokera kuchiito chechitendero.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.answer: AWA inogona kuratidza chiratidzo chakachenjera chinosiyanisa nguva yako nenguva yako yokuchena apo zviratidzo zvomudzimu zvinobvumirwa.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.questio: AWA inoratidza sei nguva yokutangazve munyengetero?
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.subtitl: Chinhu chinoratidza kuti nguva yako yapera.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.answer: Kana kuchena kuchidzoka nguva ino yeminamato isati yapera, purogiramu yacho inogona kuratidza kuti munamato uyu unenge wava kutendeka zvakare.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.question: Kutevera kutsanya kunoshanda sei?
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.subtitle: Mazuva anoverengwa nokuti hauna nguva.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.answer: AWA inogona kupa counter yemazuva ekuzvinyima zvokudya akakundikana nekuda kwemwedzi wako, kunyanya panguva yeRamadan, pamwe chete nechiyeuchidzo chinyoro mushure memwedzi kuti uronge kuagadzira.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.question: Nifas inoratidzwa sei?
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.subtitle: Chinhu chinoratidza kuti pfungwa dzinogona kusiyana.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.answer: AWA inogona kuratidza chiitiko chechitendero chakasarudzwa kwenguva yakareba ye nifas, ichinyatsocherechedza kusiyana pakati pezvikoro uko zvirimo zvinovimbiswa zvinovhara.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.question: AWA inopa mazano here pamusoro pezvekuita?
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.subtitle: Zvinhu zvinodzidzisa, kwete fatwa yakasarudzwa.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.answer: AWA inogona kupa ruzivo rwedzidzo yakajairika pamusoro pe istihada uye zvazvinoreva pakuita.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.question: Chii chandingaita kuti ndiwane mubhuku rangu?
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Zviratidzo, mafungiro, ukama, kurara uye kuita.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answer: Magazini yeDaily inobata zviratidzo zvomuviri, mamiriro ezvinhu emanzwiro, ukama hwepedyo, kurara, kuita basa romuviri, uye manotsi omunhu oga.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Zviratidzo, mafungiro, kurara, kuita basa, hydration, nguva uye manotsi.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answerDa: Magazini yeDaily inokubvumira kuongorora zviratidzo zvomuviri, mafungiro, kurara, kuita basa, kuora mwoyo, nguva yokubuda muchicheche, uye zvinyorwa zvako.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.question: Chikamu changu cheUshamwari hwepedyo chinogona kudzivirirwa here?
help.faq.journal-intimacy.subtitle: Chikamu chakasiyana, chakadzikama.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.answer: Hungu, chikamu cheUshamwari hwepedyo chinogona kuvanzwa uye kudzivirirwa nePIN kana kuti Face ID yayo yoga.
